text: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: The program is aimed for making you to be medical professionals with strong potential to meet the needs of modern medical development. Designed to train students who are enabled to develop morally, intellectually, physically and aesthetically as clinical specialists. Be armed with sound basic knowledge expertise, and skills in modern medicine. Can be qualified for teaching and research work done in the field of clinical medicine. To do the internship in the JNU First Affiliated Hospital. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Students will study a various kind of medical courses. Systemic Anatomy, Histology & Embryology, Human Physiology, Pathology, Medical Microbiology, Pharmacology, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics, Pediatrics, Preventive and Social Medicine, etc. Click here for more courses details >> 3. Graduation​ Editor Notes: Upon meeting the requirements and pass graduation exam, you will be awarded degree certificate. On completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by Jinan University, if they meet the degree regulations of the university. The English copy of the degree will state Bachelor's degree in Medicine. 4. Brief Introduction to Jinan University Editor Notes: Chemistry, Clinical Medicine, Biology & Biochemistry, Pharmacology & Toxicology, Material Science, Engineering and Agricultural Sciences rank top 1% in the world. Jinan University, established in 1906, is a comprehensive university under the joint leadership of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the Education Ministry of P. R. China. The university is one of the top 100 national key universities in China. Adhering to the principle of "Oriented to students from overseas, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan", Jinan University now has over 23,000 full time students, including 10,609 students from Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and foreign countries, which comprises the largest number of overseas students in China. Learn More about Jinan University>> 5. About School of Medicine Editor Notes: School of Medicine is recognized by WHO and faculty members are extremely excellent. The School of Medicine at Jinan University was the first medical school in China within a comprehensive university. Registered with the World Health Organization (WHO) in 1984, enabling international graduates to attend the qualification exam for doctors in their home countries. Rated as an Outstanding Doctor Training Pilot Project School and boasts a highly qualified and specialized teaching team. Faculty members have won national and/or provincial awards; and published articles in internationally renowned publications including Science, Nature Medicine and The Lancet.
